source_issue.title: Workflow comment and include contained items

summary_markdown:
# Workflow comment and include contained items

## What this issue is about
This issue is for enhancing the workflow in the Volto project by adding support for comments in the workflow and the ability to include contained items in workflow actions.

## What needs to be done
- Implement a workflow comment field.
- Add support for including contained items in the workflow dropdown menu.

Please note that this issue is currently blocked by another issue in the Plone REST API. You can view that [here](https://github.com/plone/plone.restapi/issues/333).

## Helpful background
The issue has partly been addressed, as the contents view modal now allows for the inclusion of contained items. However, the workflow comment feature and complete dropdown functionality are still pending. 

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the existing functionality in the `ContentsWorkflowModal.jsx` file in Volto.
2. Review the blocked issue for context on why this enhancement cannot be fully implemented yet.
3. Consider discussing any ideas or questions in the comments section for clarification.
4. Your contributions will likely need to be tested and reviewed after implementation.
